notes: Fixes personal Telegram alerts failing silently: a failed DM (bot blocked, chat not found, bad token, ...) was previously discarded with no trace anywhere, now logged to storage/logs/laravel.log. Also adds a 'Send test alert' button on Telegram Channel > Alerts (next to Add recipient) that DMs every connected recipient immediately and reports the exact result - success, or the specific failure reason per recipient - without waiting for a real event or needing the alert toggles on. No database update needed for this update.
